name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 1.63 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
